pr.title: Bump Radius installation pins to v0.60.2
pr.author: nellshamrell

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Azure.Storage.Queues.Tests, Azure.Storage.Queues, Azure.Storage... / Azure.Storage.Queues (windows-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: ConformanceTests.TracingEnablesTheRightActivitySource(_Keyed) fail with a RemoteExecutor timeout caused by Azure Identity credential chain hanging on the sandboxed Windows runner (IMDS/managed identity probes to 169.254.169.254). The PR only changes Radius installation pins/tests, unrelated to Azure.Storage.Queues conformance tests.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests, Hosting.Azure, Hosting.Azure, tests/Aspire... / Hosting.Azure (ubuntu-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: AzureServiceBusExtensionsTests.AzureServiceBusEmulatorResourceGeneratesConfigJsonOnlyChangedProperties fails with a TaskCanceledException during DistributedApplication.StopAsync, matching a previously tracked flaky shutdown-timeout issue. Unrelated to the PR's Radius-only changes.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, winui-debug)
failed_jobs.reason: Job fails with a generic 'Process completed with exit code 1' and no fetchable logs or TRX test failures, matching a previously tracked flaky pattern for this shard. Unrelated to the PR's Radius-only changes.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: Both Blazor browser debugger E2E tests time out after ~300s waiting for the WASM root debug session to attach, matching a previously tracked recurring (22 occurrences) flaky pattern unrelated to the PR's Radius-only changes.
